schema_front.purpose: The ontology schema as the proposer's working instructions: a CLOSED entity-type inventory (definitions + boundary examples) and a relation inventory with endpoint type signatures. In round 1 the proposer worked from a hardcoded contract-shaped prompt and emitted descriptive noun phrases as entities (85.2% of Tier-1 endpoints never resolved to a gold mention). This schema is what round 2 intended to put in front of it — see round2_wiring_audit for why it could not be delivered through existing config.

entity_inventory.definition: A gene or its product (protein / RNA) as named in the text: an official gene symbol or a full gene/protein name, including a short form defined in the same abstract (DP-B7). Case is part of the name and is preserved exactly (DP-B6): ALLCAPS, mixed-case and capitalized symbols can denote different genes in different species.
form_examples: a full gene or protein name
an in-abstract defined short form of either

population_counts: 2 of 212 children and adolescents with NHL

entity_inventory.definition: A disease, syndrome, disorder, phenotype or clinical condition as named in the text. A disease name that CONTAINS a gene name is a disease, not the gene: 'congenital antithrombin deficiency' is a disease; 'antithrombin' is the gene/protein (see merge_prohibitions MP-1).
form_examples: a named phenotypic feature or clinical condition

population_counts: 2 of 212 children and adolescents with NHL

entity_inventory.definition: A chemical substance, drug or compound as named in the text, including a short form defined in the same abstract (DP-B7). A dose, concentration or regimen attached to a chemical is NOT part of the entity and is never an entity itself.
form_examples: an in-abstract defined short form (e.g. a parenthesized abbreviation at first mention)

population_counts: 2 of 212 children and adolescents with NHL

entity_inventory.definition: One specific, named sequence variant: an rsID, an HGVS-style designation, or a textually named single variant. A free-text DESCRIPTION of mutational findings (counts of mutations, a deletion described without naming the specific variant as an entity) is a result statement, not a variant entity.
form_examples: a named amino-acid or nucleotide substitution

population_counts: 2 of 212 children and adolescents with NHL

entity_inventory.definition: A named, established cell line. Extracted as an entity (DP-B2), but the census attests ZERO gold relations with a CellLine endpoint: relations are sought among Gene / Disease / Chemical / Variant endpoints (see relation_inventory).

population_counts: 2 of 212 children and adolescents with NHL

entity_inventory.definition: Species / strain context. Per DP-B3 it is recorded as a qualifier on gene and variant mentions (species determines gene identity) and is NEVER minted as an entity and NEVER a relation endpoint.

population_counts: 2 of 212 children and adolescents with NHL

relation_inventory.definition: A stated relatedness between two in-inventory entities that the text does not characterize more specifically. The corpus default bucket (52.1% of gold) and round 1's worst recall (0.030).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Spans nearly every pair among the four types (census top pairs: Disease~Gene, Gene~Gene, Disease~Variant, Chemical~Gene). Undirected (DP-B5).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: EXPLICIT: when the text states that two in-inventory entities are related, associated, linked, co-implicated or involved together — without stating a more specific relation from this inventory — emit Association for that pair. Round 1 almost never proposed these. Mere co-occurrence in one abstract without a stated link is NOT sufficient; the link must be stated (attestation rules unchanged).

relation_inventory.definition: The presence, increase, expression or severity of one entity accompanies / predicts / increases the other.
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Emit when the text states a positive association in level, frequency or severity — stronger than bare Association because a direction of co-variation is stated.

relation_inventory.definition: The presence or increase of one entity accompanies the decrease, inhibition or absence of the other.
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Emit when the text states inhibition, reduction or inverse association.

relation_inventory.definition: Physical binding between a gene product and a chemical, or between two gene products.
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Emit only for stated physical binding, not for generic interaction language (that is Association).

relation_inventory.signature_note: Census: 4/4 Chemical~Chemical. Undirected (DP-B5). Zero instances in Dev — unmeasurable on this slice (declared in round 1).

relation_inventory.definition: A stated interaction between two chemicals/drugs.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Census: 13/13 Chemical~Chemical. Undirected (DP-B5). Zero instances in Dev — unmeasurable on this slice (declared in round 1).

merge_prohibitions.rule: Never merge entities of different schema types. Canonical case (round 1's hard-contaminated cluster): the gene 'antithrombin' (SERPINC1) must never merge with the diseases 'congenital antithrombin deficiency' or 'type I congenital antithrombin deficiency', however strong the name overlap.
merge_prohibitions.rationale: Biomedical disease/activity names systematically contain gene names, so surface containment merges across types by construction in this domain.
merge_prohibitions.expressiveness: NOT EXPRESSIBLE in the current pipeline — declared gap EG-R2-2. Mentions carry no schema type anywhere in the batch path (candidates are untyped surface strings; WRITE's er_match decides on surface form, document provenance and the Jev gate score only). A type-aware prohibition has no typed operands to evaluate. Closing it requires entity typing upstream of ER — a pipeline code change, forbidden in round 2. NOT implemented.

merge_prohibitions.rule: Name containment alone is not identity: a shorter name contained in a longer phrase merges only when the longer phrase is a form variant OF THE SAME TYPE (e.g. a name plus its own defined short form). Activity phrases ('plasma antithrombin activity'), deficiency phrases and study phrases containing an entity name are different referents.
merge_prohibitions.rationale: 121 of round 1's 125 merges were unguarded within-doc form-variant merges; the contaminated clusters arrived through exactly this channel.
merge_prohibitions.expressiveness: NOT EXPRESSIBLE in the current pipeline — same gap EG-R2-2 (no typing) compounded by the within-doc deterministic channel having no configuration surface at all (is_form_variant is code, not config). NOT implemented.

carryovers_unchanged.DP-B5: all relations undirected; unordered pair identity
carryovers_unchanged.DP-B6: no case-folding; case preserved on all surfaces
carryovers_unchanged.DP-B7: abbreviation binding only via in-abstract definition chains or the Jev ER gate; no global symbol table
carryovers_unchanged.thresholds: pinned from CUAD: triple 0.25, review band 0.25-0.50, ER threshold 0.4, G-33 cross-doc merge minimum p_same 0.85
